faqs.question: How do I check availability or enquire about products from MSV Goat Farm?
faqs.answer: You can contact MSV Goat Farm directly via WhatsApp or telephone. Product pricing and current stock availability are shared directly during your enquiry rather than listed online.

faqs.question: What products are currently available at MSV Goat Farm?
faqs.answer: Our confirmed farm offerings are live goats for sale, traditional dried goat meat — Uppukandam (உப்புக்கண்டம்), and goat milk, based in Theni, Tamil Nadu.

faqs.question: Do you offer online checkout or home delivery?
faqs.answer: There is no online shopping cart or online payment on this website. Please reach out on WhatsApp or telephone to discuss current availability and enquiry details directly with the farm.

faqs.question: Can I visit the goat farm in Theni before purchasing?
faqs.answer: Farm visit details and timings can be confirmed directly with the farm owner via WhatsApp or phone prior to your visit.
